pr_title: Fix windows key blocking applying when window is inactive / when watching a replay
pr_body:
By relying on the new local gameplay state we resolve both these issues in one swoop.

Closes #10467.

issue_context.title: windows key cannot be used in autoplay/replays
issue_context.body:
**Describe the bug:** when watching autoplay (or any replays), windows key cannot be used. if the lazer window is selected, it will open the start menu once but pressing the windows key again wont close it (essentially, the key cannot be used again). when the lazer window is not selected, pressing windows key wont open the start menu. this also affects shortcuts that has wiindows key in it (e.g. win + r for run dialog box). on sdl, windows key cannot be used. not even opening the start menu once like in osutk nor when the lazer window is delected and shortcuts is affected.

**Screenshots or videos showing encountered issue:** 
(sorry for uploading here, i cant access drive for some reason)
This was made while lazer is in osutk. i used onscreen keyboard for demonstration but its the same when using a physical keyboard
[kjkn.mkv.zip](https://github.com/ppy/osu/files/5358391/kjkn.mkv.zip)

**osu!lazer version:** 2020.1009.0 on windows 10 2004 19041.508

**Logs:**
[runtime.log](https://github.com/ppy/osu/files/5358397/runtime.log)
comments:
This brings up two issues:

- `WindowsKeyBlocker` needs to be updated to ready for `LocalUserInGameplay` state
- Windows key blocking needs to be turned off by us when the window becomes inactive

review_comments: Ah yeah, realised halfway that it can never be null (this component is only ever used in `OsuGameDesktop`). Will remove the null allowance.
